summary: Rebuilt the stripped pyjwt skeleton under jwt/: utils, algorithms (HMAC/RSA/RSA-PSS/EC/OKP/none with JWK import/export), JWS and JWT encode/decode with claim validation, and the JWK, JWK set, cache and JWKS client classes. The last full-suite run showed 258 passed, 1 failed, 2 skipped, 1 xfailed; the one failure, test_get_jwt_set_sslcontext_default, needs DNS for dev-87evx9ru.auth0.com and cannot pass offline.
